items.title: python-hosting-a2a-1.0.0a260723
items.summary: The Microsoft Agent Framework has introduced version 1.0.0a260723, which adds progressive agent and workflow A2A adapters featuring native card generation, skill discovery, typed conversion, and mode-aware validation. Additionally, the app-owned A2A hosting sample has been updated to utilize the new progressive adapter surface. These enhancements improve the integration and functionality of agents in applications, streamlining development processes for developers.

items.title: python-github-copilot-1.0.0
items.summary: The Microsoft Agent Framework has promoted the agent-framework-github-copilot package from release candidate to stable, allowing developers to forward input attachments such as images and documents to GitHub Copilot as inline blobs. This update enhances the integration capabilities of GitHub Copilot, improving the development workflow for users.

items.title: python-1.12.1
items.summary: The Microsoft Agent Framework has released version 1.12.1, promoting the agent-framework-ag-ui package to stable and adding explicit prompt cache breakpoints for GPT-5.6 models. Additionally, security guidance for custom MCP Streamable HTTP clients has been introduced, and several fixes have been made to improve the functionality and reliability of tool calls and Gemini 3 thought signatures. This update enhances developer capabilities and security in building AI-driven applications.

items.title: dotnet-1.15.0
items.summary: The Microsoft Agent Framework has released dotnet-1.15.0, which includes breaking changes to the Hosting OpenAI Responses protocol helpers, enhancements for security and logging, and new examples for Dapr as an agent provider. This update improves workflow credential management and supports advanced features for OpenAI clients, making it crucial for developers to adopt these changes to enhance application security and functionality.

items.title: dotnet-1.14.0
items.summary: The Microsoft Agent Framework has released .NET version 1.14.0, which includes several breaking changes such as the graduation of various components from experimental status, enhancements to message handling, and the restructuring of the AG-UI SDK into separate packages. These updates improve functionality and stability for developers, ensuring a more robust framework for building agent-based applications.

items.title: Building Agents that Act on Your Behalf with Toolboxes in Foundry
items.summary: Microsoft Foundry has introduced Toolboxes, which enable agents to act on behalf of users by managing identity delegation for tasks such as accessing Entra-protected servers and Microsoft 365 resources. This update enhances the capability of internal employee agents, allowing for more efficient and secure interactions within organizational systems.

items.title: python-1.12.0
items.summary: The release of Python 1.12.0 introduces several updates, including an alpha Azure Cosmos DB semantic-memory context provider, enhancements to workflow and hosting capabilities, and the promotion of various components to stable or beta status. Notably, the agent-framework-foundry-hosting package is now in beta and included in the main installation surface, which improves accessibility for developers. These changes enhance the framework's functionality and stability, facilitating more robust application development.

items.title: [In preview] Public Preview: Protect sensitive generative AI telemetry in Application Insights and Microsoft Foundry
items.summary: Microsoft Foundry has introduced a public preview feature that allows Azure Monitor Application Insights to store generative AI content in a dedicated GenAIContent table, enabling enhanced access controls for sensitive AI telemetry. This update is significant as it improves data security and compliance for developers handling sensitive information in their applications.

items.title: Announcing: Tracing for Microsoft Agent Framework (Python and .NET)
items.summary: Microsoft Foundry has introduced tracing for the Microsoft Agent Framework in public preview for both Python and .NET, enabling developers to monitor agent behavior, tool interactions, and model engagements during execution. This enhancement is significant for improving debugging and performance analysis in agent-based applications.

items.title: Announcing: Multi-agent orchestration patterns including Magentic in Microsoft Agent Framework
items.summary: Microsoft Agent Framework has reached general availability for multi-agent orchestration patterns, introducing the Magentic pattern, which achieved a 38 percent improvement on GAIA and competitive results on AssistantBench and WebArena benchmarks. This update enhances developers' capabilities in creating more efficient and effective multi-agent systems.

items.title: Announcing: Multi-agent orchestration SDK with the Microsoft Foundry Agent Framework in C# and Python
items.summary: Microsoft Foundry has launched the Agent Framework, a multi-agent orchestration SDK available in C# and Python. This update consolidates existing patterns from AutoGen and Semantic Kernel, providing developers with a unified set of abstractions, which simplifies the development process and enhances the efficiency of building multi-agent systems.

items.title: Announcing: GitHub Copilot and Claude Code connectors in Microsoft Agent Framework
items.summary: Microsoft Agent Framework has introduced generally available connectors for GitHub Copilot and Claude Code, enabling developers to create .NET and Python agents that can delegate coding tasks seamlessly. This update simplifies the integration process, allowing for more efficient development workflows without the need for custom adapter code.

items.title: Announcing: Episodic procedural memory in Microsoft Agent Framework
items.summary: Microsoft Agent Framework has introduced episodic procedural memory in public preview, allowing agents to remember and replay successful task patterns for similar future requests. This enhancement improves the efficiency and effectiveness of agent interactions, making them more responsive to user needs.

items.title: Announcing: DevUI Agent Inspector for Microsoft Agent Framework
items.summary: Microsoft Agent Framework has introduced the DevUI Agent Inspector in public preview, providing developers with a local debugging interface that displays agent runs as a navigable tree. This feature allows for pausing, replaying, and editing prompts during execution, enhancing the debugging process and improving development efficiency.

items.title: Announcing: CodeAct pattern and Hyperlight containers in Microsoft Agent Framework
items.summary: Microsoft Agent Framework has introduced the CodeAct pattern in public preview, allowing agents to consolidate multi-step plans into a single executable code block, significantly reducing end-to-end latency in representative workloads. This enhancement streamlines agent operations, improving efficiency for developers.

items.title: Announcing: Agent Harness in Microsoft Agent Framework
items.summary: Microsoft Agent Framework has reached general availability for Agent Harness, allowing customers to transition their pilot agents into production seamlessly while maintaining backward compatibility. This update is significant as it enables developers to deploy their agent solutions reliably in a production environment.

items.title: Announcing: Agent Channel for Microsoft Agent Framework multi-agent communication
items.summary: Microsoft Agent Framework has introduced the Agent Channel in public preview, allowing agents to communicate through structured messages without the need for custom routing code. This feature supports both request-response and fire-and-forget messaging, streamlining multi-agent interactions and enhancing development efficiency.

items.title: Foundry Local CLI 0.10.2 (Preview)
items.summary: Foundry Local CLI 0.10.2 restores the original Microsoft.FoundryLocal MSIX package identity so Windows and winget perform in-place upgrades instead of installing a duplicate app. Users of earlier 0.10.x builds should uninstall the duplicate package before upgrading.

items.title: Foundry Local CLI 0.10.2 (Preview)
items.summary: The Foundry Local CLI 0.10.2 (Preview) has restored the MSIX package identity to Microsoft.FoundryLocal, enabling proper winget upgrades and in-place MSIX upgrades for users. This change resolves issues from the previous version that treated the app as separate, ensuring a smoother upgrade process for developers. Users are advised to uninstall earlier 0.10.x builds to prevent duplicate installations.

items.title: python-1.11.0
items.summary: Agent Framework Python 1.11 adds mid-run message injection, progressive MCP tool disclosure, context-aware skill filtering, cache TTLs, hosting protocol helpers, and long-stream keepalives. The release also includes experimental breaking changes and multi-workflow Durable Task hosting updates.

items.title: Microsoft Foundry docs: What's new for June 2026 - Microsoft Foundry
items.summary: Discover documentation and product updates in Microsoft Foundry for June 2026.

items.title: What’s New in Microsoft Foundry | June 2026
items.summary: The June roundup covers Claude GA, autopilot agents, Toolboxes and Routines, richer Memory, Foundry Local on Azure Local, Voice Live updates, and the Agent Optimizer private preview. Availability varies by capability, so this guide cross-checks individual status against Azure Updates and Microsoft Learn.

items.title: dotnet-1.13.0
items.summary: The .NET 1.13.0 release introduces several enhancements, including improved shell handling for dotnet-format, added skill approval options, and per-user session isolation for Foundry Hosting. Notably, it also includes breaking changes to the FileAccess/FileMemory store API and refactors OpenAI Hosting options for better security and usability.

items.title: dotnet-1.12.0
items.summary: The .NET 1.12.0 release introduces several enhancements, including OAuth consent support for Foundry hosted-agent toolbox and a new BackgroundTaskCompletionLoopEvaluator for harness background agents. It also includes breaking changes, such as aligning Foundry.Hosting experimental flags with MAAI001 and extracting caching functionality into a new CachingAgentSkillsSource, improving overall framework stability and functionality.

items.title: Claude models generally available in Microsoft Foundry
items.summary: Anthropic's Claude Opus, Sonnet, and Haiku families are now GA in Foundry with Azure-hosted and Anthropic-hosted deployment options, Entra ID auth, Marketplace billing (CCUs), MACC eligibility, and zero-data-retention options for regulated workloads.

items.title: [Launched] Public Preview: Document PII playground sample in Microsoft Foundry NextGen
items.summary: A public-preview sample playground in the Microsoft Foundry portal demonstrates document-based PII detection and redaction using a prepared document, making the feature easier to evaluate before integrating it into an application.

items.title: [Launched] Generally Available: Document PII NextGen Playground in Azure AI Language
items.summary: The refreshed Document PII playground is generally available in Azure AI Language, with curated sample inputs and outputs for evaluating document-level PII detection and redaction in the Microsoft Foundry experience.

items.title: python-1.10.0
items.summary: The agent-framework version 1.10.0 introduces several enhancements, including explicit emission of available resources in skill content, improved error handling for skill scripts, and the addition of a FoundryAgent conversation session helper. Key changes include breaking updates to file access approvals and the Foundry Hosted Agent V2 protocol upgrade, which enhance security and functionality for developers.

items.title: [Launched] Generally Available: Toolboxes in Microsoft Foundry
items.summary: Toolboxes are generally available in Microsoft Foundry, providing a reusable, governed endpoint for tools that can be invoked by prompt agents or external clients instead of rebuilding separate tool lists for every agent.

items.title: dotnet-1.11.1
items.summary: Agent Framework .NET 1.11.1 makes AgentSkillsProvider tools require approval by default, adds AOT-safe declarative workflow checkpointing options, and fixes checkpoint-resume behavior. Review the release notes before upgrading because the approval default is a breaking change.

items.title: Microsoft Agent Framework 1.0 released
items.summary: The open-source SDK unifying Semantic Kernel and AutoGen hits 1.0 for Python and .NET — agents, typed workflows, orchestration patterns (sequential, concurrent, handoff, Magentic), MCP/A2A/OpenAPI interop, and OpenTelemetry built in.

items.title: Model Router reaches general availability
items.summary: Foundry's Model Router automatically routes each request to the best-fit model for quality vs. cost across the catalog — swap or add underlying models without changing application code.

items.title: Microsoft Foundry unveiled at Ignite 2025
items.summary: Azure AI Foundry becomes Microsoft Foundry: a redesigned agent-first portal, hosted agents for any framework, Foundry IQ knowledge bases, the Foundry Control Plane for Day 2 operations, and Entra Agent ID for agent identity.

items.title: Hosted agents in Foundry Agent Service (public preview)
items.summary: Bring code-first agents built with Microsoft Agent Framework, LangGraph, or CrewAI into Foundry as managed container-based agents — invoked via the Responses API with built-in scaling, identity, tracing, and governance.

items.title: AI Red Teaming Agent and continuous evaluations in the Control Plane
items.summary: Automated adversarial testing built on PyRIT plus agentic evaluators (intent resolution, tool-call accuracy, task adherence) now run pre-deployment and continuously against live traffic from the Foundry Control Plane.
